title: AI Engineering Capstone — Prove Quality, Safety, and Operations
key_insight: Test normal, missing-evidence, adversarial, and failure cases. Report quality slices, latency percentiles, cost, permissions, and rollback behavior.
body:
## Prove Quality, Safety, and Operations

A demo answers the happy path, but there is no evidence for edge cases, privacy, latency, cost, or recovery.

Test normal, missing-evidence, adversarial, and failure cases. Report quality slices, latency percentiles, cost, permissions, and rollback behavior.

Deploy to a bounded audience or realistic staging environment. Capture one incident drill and the improvement it caused.
common_mistakes: The largest possible scope makes the strongest capstone.
A happy-path demo proves production readiness.
Code alone explains every design tradeoff.
mini_exercise: Draw “Prove Quality, Safety, and Operations” as three labeled steps, then explain the decision at each step.
real_world_usage: A complete artifact demonstrates integration across data, models, product decisions, safety, and reliable delivery.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Prove Quality, Safety, and Operations,” explain AI Engineering Capstone without assuming the listener knows AI engineering.

build_task.title: Ship the curriculum capstone
build_task.context: Turn AI Engineering Capstone into one small, inspectable artifact.
steps: Choose and scope one AI product.
Run quality, safety, latency, cost, and failure tests.
Deploy in a bounded setting and write the decision report.
build_task.expected_output: A versioned artifact with visible decisions, evidence, and failure handling.
build_task.hint: Keep the scope bounded and record why each decision was made.
